facts.text: PythonMicroscopeFocusMotor is a FocusMotorBase adapter for a python-microscope stage or stage axis
The adapter requires exactly one of device, device_factory or device_uri
connect() enables the device, resolves the configured axis and marks the motor connected
move_absolute() divides Z by position_scale and calls the axis' move_to() in device units
get_current_z() reads axis.position and multiplies it by position_scale
get_position_limits() reads the axis' limits.lower and limits.upper and converts both with position_scale
get_is_moving() reads the axis' moving/is_moving attribute or get_is_moving() method, and otherwise compares the current Z with the last commanded target using at_target_tolerance
FocusMotorBase defines move_absolute, get_current_z, get_is_moving and get_position_limits as its abstract device methods and has no stop primitive
position_scale converts python-microscope stage units into the absolute Z units MagScope uses; for example 1000.0 converts an axis that reports micrometres into nanometres
MagScope Z-Lock corrections are in nanometres
